title: Three Shifts and One Short Switch
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：motor　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 motor 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the operator ① started the motor that no trainee in the station would have described, and he said the starting was the whole of the shift. The ② motor, meaning the engine itself and not the switch, ran three shifts and stayed undescribed in the book; a motor, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ motor in that station had the same short switch beside it, and the ④ motor at the far screen, meaning the cable they kept for the children to check and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A motor, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the operator said the describing is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the motor was the whole of the matter, meaning the power and not the engine. The ⑥ motor, meaning the power and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; motor, he said, is either something you start or the only word that means both an engine and a power. He said the power is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ motor had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short switch. The ⑧ motor of the whole thing, the operator wrote in June, was one station and three shifts of describing; motor, he said, is either the cable at the far screen or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ motor I remember is the engine described in the log, which closed in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ motor, my mother said in 1974, is the only engine that improves by being described; every motor, she said, is a power that has agreed to look like an engine. She said the power was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 发动机；马达（指机房里每一台旁边的那一台）
B. n. 发动机；马达（指那台发动机本身，与小小的开关相对）
C. 固定搭配：start the motor 发动这一台发动机
D. n. 发动机；马达（指留给孩子们查的那一根）
E. n. 发动机之事（抽象总称，指一处机房的发动机之事）
F. n. 发动机；马达（指运行日志里写到、被描述的那一台）
G. n. 发动机、动力（指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 动力（抽象总称，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: started the motor that no trainee in the station would have described
The motor, meaning the engine itself and not the switch
the motor at the far screen
the motor was the whole of the matter

The motor of the whole thing

answers.why: start the motor 意为“发动这一台发动机”，1965 年那位操作员把机房里没有一位实习生肯描述的一台发动机做了一遍。
motor 意为“发动机；马达”，指那台发动机本身而不是小小的开关，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被描述。
motor 意为“发动机；马达”，指机房里每一台旁边的那一台，每一台旁边都有同一个小小的开关。
motor 意为“发动机；马达”，指最远那块屏幕的留给孩子们查的那一根，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
motor 意为“发动机、动力”，指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这台动力就是那件事的全部。
motor 意为“动力”，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西而不是那台发动机，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
motor 意为“发动机；马达”，指运行日志里写到、被描述的那一台，到 1970 年这一台成了运行日志里的一行。
motor 意为“发动机之事”，操作员六月写道，整件事的发动机之事是一处机房和三个班次的描述。
motor 意为“发动机；马达”，我记得的是运行日志里描述过的那一台，1972 年调好了，至今仍被说成机房里最安静的一台。
motor 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，发动机是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的发动机。
